<article title="Order tracking">
You can follow your order from the Orders page of your account. Once a package leaves our warehouse, the order shows a carrier name and a tracking number, and the carrier's page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If the tracking page has not updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case we can open a trace with the carrier; a trace usually resolves within five business days.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse the same day. Orders placed later, or on weekends, leave the next business day.

</article>

Customer first name: Sebastián
<request>
estimate said three days
checkout said three days and it has been four since i ordered. where is it?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Sebastián,

Thanks for reaching out! I understand your concern about the delivery timeline.

To help you best, I'd recommend checking the Orders page in your account for the most current tracking information. Once your package left our warehouse, it should show a carrier name and tracking number. You can monitor progress on the carrier's page, which typically updates within 24 hours of each scan.

If the tracking hasn't updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case, we can open a trace with the carrier to investigate further.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to review your specific order details.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
